main.description: Apply an asymmetric lens to a source record. Returns the translated record and the complement (residual data stripped by the get direction). The complement can be persisted as a dev.panproto.schema.complement record for later reconstruction.

lens.description: AT-URI of the lens to apply.

source.description: AT-URI of the source record to translate.

direction.description: Which direction to run the lens.

complement.description: AT-URI of a complement record. Required when direction is 'put'.

persistComplement.description: If true, persist the complement as a record and return its AT-URI.

complementUri.description: AT-URI of the persisted complement record, if persistComplement was true.

errors.name: ComplementRequired
errors.description: Direction is 'put' but no complement was provided.

errors.name: TypeMismatch
errors.description: Source record does not conform to the lens's source schema.
